name: AI-PROMPT-sfx-9a28f58fb3df
annotation:
本轮原型的最小音效集

Purpose: minimal SFX set for "Candle Prototype Arena" prototype (NIGHT-001).
Needed one-shots (each 0.1-0.6 s, mono, 48 kHz WAV or OGG):
1. pistol_shot - short filtered crack, slight low-end thump.
2. shotgun_blast - wider burst, 0.35 s.
3. reload_click - two-stage mechanical click (mag out/in).
4. melee_swipe - whoosh with light impact layer.
5. dodge_dash - airy short whoosh.
6. enemy_telegraph - rising 300-600 Hz tone 0.3 s (attack wind-up warning).
7. enemy_hit - dry thud.
8. enemy_death - downward pitch blip.
9. player_hurt - soft low thump + brief noise.
10. barricade_break - wood crack crumble 0.5 s.
11. ui_click / ui_confirm - neutral ticks.
Constraints: no licensing ambiguity (CC0 or owned only); levels roughly matched (-12 dBFS peaks); no long reverb tails.
prototype_only: placeholder until reviewed.
